t: You're looking at numbers thirty-five and thirty-seven Harrington Gardens, a building in Kensington and Chelsea. It was designed by Ernest George. Sir Ernest George was an English architect, and also a landscape and architectural watercolourist and an etcher. So the man who drew up these houses was an accomplished artist as well as a builder's designer, and that double talent is worth keeping in mind as you look at the facade in front of you.
